summary: Round 1 had no findings. Since then, commit eb4edeb changed no files under src/. The only code changes are tests/bots/maniac.test.ts, tests/bots/maniac.acceptance.test.ts and package.json. In package.json, the test:slow script now also runs tests/bots/maniac.test.ts with TLH_SLOW_TESTS=1. That is a static dev-only script: no new dependencies, and no untrusted input reaches it. The test files only run under vitest and are not shipped. The working tree has only a backlog task markdown change. No new attack surface. The round-1 analysis still stands (validator fails closed, actions come from legalActions, seeded BotRandom, no hidden-information access).
